adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an immediate OAuth refresh call in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` during service setup: it does `await fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` unconditionally (no expiry check shown) before returning a `new jsforce.Connection(...)`. This introduces an outbound network dependency for every service instantiation/use path and the call has no timeout/abort handling (plain `fetch`), so a slow/hung Salesforce endpoint can stall Salesforce operations. It also throws on non-"OK" responses (`if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)`), which can fail the whole service creation path.
